claims.explanation: Dofetilide is a potent hERG (KCNH2) blocker that inhibits the rapidly activating delayed rectifier potassium current (IKr), and cancer cell lines expressing high levels of KCNH2 or other annotated potassium channel targets likely depend on these channels for survival, leading to selective killing. Mutations in PI3K/AKT pathway and chromatin/splicing regulators may modulate KCNH2 expression or downstream survival, with PTEN/BRAF/SF3B1/EP300/KMT2C enriched in sensitive lines and PIK3CA/NF2 enriched in resistant lines.
